a1
The Lord appeared to Abraham at Mamre. He looked up and saw three men.
b1
He ran to meet them: do not pass by. Let me bring water and bread.
b2
Abraham and Sarah hurried to prepare a feast.
c1
They asked: where is Sarah? One said: I will return, and Sarah will have a son.
c2
Sarah, listening at the tent, laughed to herself.
c3
The Lord said: is anything too hard for the Lord?
d1
Then he said: the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. I will go down and see.
d2
Abraham asked: will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked? Will the Judge of all the earth not do justice?
d3
What if there are fifty righteous? The Lord said: for their sake I will spare it.
e1
Abraham kept asking: forty-five, forty, thirty, twenty.
e2
Finally: what about ten? The Lord said: for ten, I will not destroy it.
h1
Abraham welcomed strangers, and met the Lord.
h2
Then he stood before God and pleaded for a city that was not even his own.
h3
Prayer is not only asking for ourselves. It is standing before God for others.
h4
Today, pray for someone by name.
i
Whose name will you bring to God today?
